in_marathi.name: Gyanada
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gyanada हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gyanada is a Sanskrit name derived from the word gyana, meaning knowledge or wisdom. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with goddess Saraswati, the deity of learning and wisdom.
